video.title: Why do we go to church?

scenes.speaker: person
scenes.text: Jesus... why do we go to church every Sunday?

scenes.speaker: jesus
scenes.text: Do you think church is only a building?

scenes.speaker: person
scenes.text: Then why do we need to gather together?

scenes.speaker: jesus
scenes.text: Where two or three are gathered in My name, there am I with them.

scenes.speaker: bible_verse
scenes.text: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

scenes.speaker: engagement
scenes.text: What does church mean to you? Share your answer in the comments.

bible.text: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
